correctness.rationale: Exact four-term finite-field character sum (1) is reconstructed, including intersecting coordinate lines. Nontrivial additive characters have all pth roots as image; nearest-antipodal angle yields 2|c|sin(pi/(2p)). Norm Q>=2|c|(q-1) is sharp only at c=-1, which realizes minimum after exhaustive translation/frequency case proof. Weyl character diagonalization gives N|A|²/Q², and equality-set incidence yields K(q) including the q=3 boundary. Standalone direct finite-field checker executes successfully for p=3,5,7,11 and F9. Finite checks do not imply infinite proof.

value.rationale: Sharp exact quantitative stability of all-matrix Gabor intensity lifting is a motivated invariant, with explicit sparse complete-operator-design relevance. Unique opposite-phase optimizer is not a gratuitous substitution; its p-dependent constant, full-rank guarantee, exact weak eigenvalue and characteristic-three equality multiplicity furnish meaningful structure beyond the general injectivity criterion. Scope and unproved extensions are honestly limited.
